title: A split-domain nonlinear wave design study

formulation.energy_key_note: Internal energy keys denote normalized mean-square voltage, not stored physical capacitive energy.
formulation.units: Normalized Z0=1, incident voltage=1, x in reference wavelengths; all values dimensionless
formulation.weak_form: int(Vprime wprime/z + (alpha+i beta c)Vw + i beta chi |V|^2 Vw)dx + (Vleft-Vright)(wleft-wright)/Zs + V(0)w(0)=2w(0)
formulation.adjoint: J^T lambda=f_u; df/dc=f_c-lambda^T F_c; separate real/imaginary unknowns
formulation.nonlinearity: Fundamental-harmonic projection of synthetic cubic capacitive charge; 3/4 factor absorbed in chi. No higher-harmonic propagation, calibrated varactor model, or transient stability claim.

development_findings: Initial harness placed the first Newton evaluation outside exception capture; the high-low nonlinear failure aborted serialization. Evaluation moved inside capture and all starts rerun. No numerical failure was suppressed.
Generic unittest discover in the SciPy-only environment failed importing the separate PyTorch test. The core scientific suite passed using -p test_wave_fem.py.
protocol.pilot: Three elements/cell, uniform start: energy cap 1.6; chi 0 and .05. No constants were tuned after pilot. Pilot exposed competing basins; five fixed starts used for both final models.
protocol.history_note: Accepted SLSQP callback iterates, including initial point; fields solved at each stored iterate. Repeated terminal iterate may occur.

Manufactured cubic nonlinear solution
checks.forcing: f=-V_exact_second/z+y V_exact+i beta chi |V_exact|^2 V_exact; exact cubic on both sides plus switch jump

checks.name: Global passive power balance
checks.relative_error_note: Exact expected defect is zero; absolute tolerance applies.

limitations: Synthetic reduced-order analogue, not a calibrated metasurface or experimental result.
Local minima only; multistart is not a global optimum certificate.

Mean-square-voltage limit and amplitude floor are illustrative engineering requirements. The mean-square-voltage cap limits normalized squared field amplitude; .002 regularization mildly discourages loading far from unity. These choices were frozen after the pilot.
Cubic fundamental-only model excludes harmonics and does not establish dynamic stability.
Nonlinear Newton solve selects branch from linear initialization; no global uniqueness proof.
Agent-produced derivations and verification must be independently checked by the student team before submission.
